No snarl, no sneer, no scowl, no cruel or cunning face, no dark shadow, no weapon, nothing monstrous, nothing frightening for a four-year-old. Drawn with dignity and warmth, never mocking, never comic, never a caricature: no halo, no nimbus, no glowing ring and no golden disc behind the head. Nothing frightening for a small child.
